definition_en: To succeed in reaching a particular goal or status.
example_sentence: Students work hard to achieve good marks in their exams.

definition_en: Extremely important and necessary.
example_sentence: Regular practice is essential for learning a new language.

definition_en: To grow or cause to grow and become more mature or advanced.
example_sentence: She wants to develop her speaking skills before traveling.

definition_en: To make available for use; supply.
example_sentence: The library provides quiet study areas for students.

definition_en: To need something for a particular purpose.
example_sentence: Most academic programs require students to pass an English test.

definition_en: A task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
example_sentence: Passing the university proficiency exam is a major challenge.
collocation: face a challenge / overcome a challenge

definition_en: An advantage or profit gained from something.
example_sentence: One major benefit of early revision is reduced exam stress.

definition_en: To give a detailed account in words.
example_sentence: The author describes the economic crisis in detail.

definition_en: To make smaller or less in amount, degree, or size.
example_sentence: Recycling helps reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

definition_en: To make something ready for use or consideration.
example_sentence: She spent several months preparing for the proficiency test.
collocation: prepare thoroughly / prepare for an exam

definition_en: To examine methodically and in detail the constitution or structure of something.
example_sentence: Researchers must analyze data thoroughly before drawing conclusions.

definition_en: An abstract idea; a general notion.
example_sentence: Understanding the concept of gravity is fundamental in physics.

definition_en: To clearly show the existence or truth of something by giving proof.
example_sentence: The experiment demonstrated that the hypothesis was valid.

definition_en: To point out or show something.
example_sentence: The survey results indicate a high level of customer satisfaction.

definition_en: A particular procedure for accomplishing or approaching something.
example_sentence: Scientists employ rigorous methods to ensure repeatable findings.

definition_en: A circumstance, fact, or influence that contributes to a result.
example_sentence: Motivation is a determining factor in academic success.

definition_en: Roughly calculate or judge the value, number, or quantity.
example_sentence: Economists estimate that inflation will decline next quarter.

definition_en: The surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives.
example_sentence: A peaceful study environment fosters deeper academic concentration.

definition_en: Sufficiently great or important to be worthy of attention.
example_sentence: There has been a significant increase in renewable energy adoption.

definition_en: To put a decision, plan, or agreement into effect.
example_sentence: The government decided to implement stricter pollution controls.

definition_en: A result or effect of an action or condition.
example_sentence: Deforestation has severe environmental consequences worldwide.
collocation: dire consequences / as a consequence of

definition_en: To make an action or process easy or easier.
example_sentence: Modern digital tools facilitate rapid communication across teams.

definition_en: Of considerable importance, size, or worth.
example_sentence: A substantial amount of capital was allocated to infrastructure.

definition_en: To make or become less in size, intensity, or value.
example_sentence: Public confidence in the institution diminished following the scandal.

definition_en: To publicly recommend or support a particular cause or policy.
example_sentence: Environmentalists advocate stricter caps on carbon emissions.

definition_en: Including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something.
example_sentence: The ministry published a comprehensive report on public health.

definition_en: Certain to happen; unavoidable.
example_sentence: With the rise of automation, job market restructuring is inevitable.

definition_en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.
example_sentence: Decision makers must make rational choices based on statistical evidence.

definition_en: Significant as a cause or basis even if not readily apparent.
example_sentence: Physicians sought to address the underlying causes of the chronic illness.

definition_en: To check or prove the validity or accuracy of something.
example_sentence: Further peer reviews are needed to validate the experimental results.

definition_en: To make something bad less severe, serious, or painful.
example_sentence: Urban planning with green corridors can mitigate the heat island effect.

definition_en: Based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation rather than theory.
example_sentence: Scientific theories require robust empirical evidence before general acceptance.

definition_en: Seeming reasonable or probable.
example_sentence: The detective presented a plausible explanation for the disappearance.

definition_en: An illogical or surprising lack of compatibility between facts or figures.
example_sentence: Auditors discovered a marked discrepancy between revenue reports and bank deposits.

definition_en: To examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.
example_sentence: The regulatory committee scrutinized every clause of the proposed legislation.

definition_en: Existing in something as a permanent, essential, or characteristic attribute.
example_sentence: Every innovative investment carries an inherent level of financial risk.

definition_en: To damage or weaken the foundation, integrity, or authority of something.
example_sentence: Unsubstantiated rumors threaten to undermine public trust in democratic institutions.

definition_en: To make something clear; explain.
example_sentence: The professor held an extra workshop to elucidate complex quantum mechanics equations.
collocation: elucidate a concept / elucidate the mechanism

definition_en: Widespread in a particular area or at a particular time.
example_sentence: Confirmation bias is especially prevalent on social media echo chambers.

definition_en: Capable of working successfully; feasible.
example_sentence: Hydrogen fuel cells represent a viable alternative to internal combustion engines.

definition_en: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
example_sentence: Rising energy tariffs exacerbated the financial burdens on low-income families.

definition_en: Present, appearing, or found everywhere.
example_sentence: Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that life without them is difficult to imagine.

definition_en: To place or deal with close together for contrasting effect.
example_sentence: The museum exhibition juxtaposes ancient artifacts with modern sculptures.

definition_en: Lasting for a very short time.
example_sentence: Fame in the digital era is frequently ephemeral and easily eclipsed.

definition_en: Open to more than one interpretation; ambiguous.
example_sentence: The politician gave an equivocal response when pressed on fiscal policy.

definition_en: Impossible to stop or prevent.
example_sentence: The inexorable march of technological progress disrupts legacy industries.

definition_en: Showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise.
example_sentence: The laboratory trial required meticulous documentation of every temperature fluctuation.
collocation: meticulous research / meticulous attention to detail

definition_en: To make obscure, unclear, or unintelligible.
example_sentence: Legal jargon is often criticized for serving to obfuscate rather than clarify rights.

definition_en: To distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose.
example_sentence: The faculty decided to allocate more funding to laboratory equipment.

definition_en: Open to more than one interpretation; having a double meaning.
example_sentence: The wording of the question was so ambiguous that students protested.

definition_en: To make up for something unwelcome or unpleasant by exerting an opposite force.
example_sentence: High intelligence does not necessarily compensate for a lack of diligence.

definition_en: To rise and fall irregularly in number or amount.
example_sentence: Solar and wind energy outputs fluctuate in response to weather patterns.

definition_en: To cause an event or situation to happen or exist.
example_sentence: Stressful life events can trigger acute physical and mental exhaustion.
collocation: trigger a reaction / trigger a crisis

definition_en: A particular attitude toward or way of regarding something; a point of view.
example_sentence: Studying abroad allows undergraduates to gain an international perspective.

definition_en: The basic physical and organizational structures needed for the operation of a society.
example_sentence: Aging transportation infrastructure requires substantial state renovation.

definition_en: Enough; adequate.
example_sentence: The researchers collected sufficient experimental samples to prove the claim.

definition_en: To be of the same opinion; agree.
example_sentence: The panel of medical specialists concurred that immediate intervention was mandatory.

definition_en: To spread or disperse something (especially information) widely.
example_sentence: Scholars utilize academic journals to disseminate peer-reviewed discoveries.

definition_en: To become progressively worse.
example_sentence: Air quality in the industrial zone deteriorated substantially over winter.

definition_en: A person who advocates a theory, proposal, or course of action.
example_sentence: Proponents of nuclear energy emphasize its minimal carbon footprint.

definition_en: Never done or known before.
example_sentence: The pandemic provoked an unprecedented shutdown of worldwide aviation.

definition_en: Dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.
example_sentence: Engineers must adopt a pragmatic approach when balancing safety with strict budgets.

definition_en: To restore friendly relations between; to make consistent.
example_sentence: It is arduous to reconcile rapid economic expansion with ecological preservation.

definition_en: Likely or liable to be influenced or harmed by a particular thing.
example_sentence: Elderly populations are particularly susceptible to seasonal respiratory infections.

definition_en: a piece of work or job that you are given to do in a course of study
example_sentence: Students must submit their reading assignment before Friday midnight.
turkish_hint: Öğretmenin veya profesörün verdiği ev ödevi ya da proje.

definition_en: to be present at an event, meeting, or class
example_sentence: You must attend at least eighty percent of the prep classes to sit for the final exam.
turkish_hint: 'Attendance' (devamsızlık) kelimesinin fiil hali; bir etkinliğe veya derse fiziken katılmak.

definition_en: the latest time or date by which something should be completed
example_sentence: The professor refused to accept the research paper after the strict midnight deadline.
turkish_hint: Bir ödevin veya görevin teslim edilmesi gereken en son an.

definition_en: one of the two periods into which a year is divided at a university or college
example_sentence: During the fall semester, prep students focus heavily on grammar and academic vocabulary.
turkish_hint: Üniversitelerin güz ve bahar dönemlerinden her biri.

definition_en: a document that outlines the subjects, assignments, and exam dates for a course
example_sentence: Please consult the course syllabus to check which chapters will be covered on the midterm.
turkish_hint: Dersin ilk haftası verilen, hafta hafta ne işleneceğini gösteren plan.

definition_en: a group of departments in a university, or the teaching staff of an institution
example_sentence: The Faculty of Architecture is located on the historic Taşkışla campus.
turkish_hint: Tıp Fakültesi, Mühendislik Fakültesi gibi akademik ana birimler.

definition_en: a formal talk on a serious subject given to a group of university students
example_sentence: The guest professor gave a fascinating lecture on renewable energy in the main amphitheater.
turkish_hint: Professörün amfide öğrencilere hitaben anlattığı akademik ders.

definition_en: a score or mark indicating a student's level of performance in an examination
example_sentence: You need a grade of at least sixty-five percent to pass the proficiency examination.
turkish_hint: Sınavdan alınan harf veya sayısal not.

definition_en: to form an idea of the amount, number, or value of something; assess
example_sentence: Instructors evaluate student essays based on cohesion, lexical range, and grammatical accuracy.
turkish_hint: Bir şeyin değerini, başarısını veya kalitesini kıstaslara göre analiz etmek.

definition_en: to carry out a systematic or formal inquiry to discover and examine the facts
example_sentence: A team of environmental scientists is investigating the effects of microplastics on marine ecosystems.
turkish_hint: Dedektif veya bilim insanı gibi derinlemesine inceleme yapmak.

definition_en: a result or effect, typically one that is unwelcome or unpleasant
example_sentence: Global warming is having direct consequences on agricultural yield and water availability.
turkish_hint: Bir eylemin veya kararın arkasından gelen doğrudan etki (consequently = sonuç olarak).

definition_en: a way of dealing with a situation or problem
example_sentence: The engineering faculty adopted an interdisciplinary approach to renewable energy research.
turkish_hint: Bir meseleye nereden ve nasıl bakıldığı, benimsenecek metot.

definition_en: a fundamental truth or proposition that serves as the foundation for a system of belief or behavior
example_sentence: Conservation of energy is a fundamental principle of modern physics.
turkish_hint: Fizik kanunları veya ahlak kurallarının 'temel dayanağı'.

definition_en: to recognize or establish something as being a particular thing
example_sentence: The diagnostic test is designed to identify students' specific weaknesses in academic reading.
turkish_hint: Kimliğini veya problemin kaynağını parmakla gösterecek kadar net tespit etmek.

definition_en: to cause or enable a condition or state of affairs to continue; also to state something strongly
example_sentence: The researcher maintained that the experiment had been conducted under sterile laboratory conditions.
turkish_hint: Hem bir standardı muhafaza etmek hem de tezini savunmak.

definition_en: to get, acquire, or secure something
example_sentence: Students must obtain official approval from their advisor before dropping a course.
turkish_hint: 'Get' fiilinin resmi ve akademik karşılığı.

definition_en: the arrangement of and relations between the parts or elements of something complex
example_sentence: Your essay needs a clear five-paragraph structure with an introduction, body, and conclusion.
turkish_hint: Paragraf veya bina yapısı; bir şeyin iskeleti.

definition_en: a general direction in which something is developing or changing
example_sentence: Recent statistical data indicates a strong upward trend in electric vehicle adoption.
turkish_hint: Grafiklerde yükseliş veya düşüş yönü.

definition_en: a circumstance, fact, or influence that contributes to a result
example_sentence: Sleep deprivation is a major contributing factor to poor academic concentration.
turkish_hint: Bir sonucun ortaya çıkmasına katkı sağlayan unsurlar.

definition_en: to successfully bring about or reach a desired objective by effort or skill
example_sentence: With disciplined daily practice, any motivated student can achieve proficiency in English.
turkish_hint: 'Achievement' (başarı) kelimesinin fiil hali.

definition_en: to rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
example_sentence: Oil prices have fluctuated dramatically due to geopolitical tensions and supply bottlenecks.
turkish_hint: Borsada veya sıcaklık ölçümlerinde istikrarsız iniş çıkışlar.

definition_en: to introduce new methods, ideas, or products
example_sentence: Universities must constantly innovate their curriculum to keep pace with artificial intelligence.
turkish_hint: 'Innovation' (inovasyon/yenilik) kelimesinin fiil kökü.

definition_en: a particular attitude toward or way of regarding something; a point of view
example_sentence: Studying abroad broadens students' cultural perspective and enhances adaptability.
turkish_hint: Olaylara nereden ve hangi gözlükle baktığınız.

definition_en: to severely restrict the scope, extent, or activity of something
example_sentence: The research project was severely constrained by budget cuts and limited laboratory space.
turkish_hint: Elini kolunu bağlamak, sınır çekmek.

definition_en: to make an action or process easy or easier
example_sentence: Interactive digital tools facilitate collaborative learning among preparatory students.
turkish_hint: Bir işin daha pürüzsüz ve hızlı yürümesini sağlamak.

definition_en: to take in or contain something as part of a whole; include
example_sentence: The updated syllabus incorporates modern essay prompts reflecting current environmental challenges.
turkish_hint: Bir parçayı ana yapının içine yedirmek, entegre etmek.

definition_en: the process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another
example_sentence: The transition from high school memorization to independent university research requires discipline.
turkish_hint: Eski halden yeni hale geçiş evresi.

definition_en: to give something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury; or to counterbalance
example_sentence: High motivation and regular practice can compensate for initial shortcomings in English background.
turkish_hint: Bir eksiği başka bir fazlalıkla kapatmak (compensate for).

definition_en: to cause an event or situation to happen or exist
example_sentence: The unexpected discovery triggered an intense international debate among climatologists.
turkish_hint: Tıpkı silahın tetiği gibi bir olayı patlatıp başlatan kıvılcım.

definition_en: to make or become less
example_sentence: Without consistent revision, a student's recall of academic collocations will rapidly diminish.
turkish_hint: Zamanla kuvvetini veya miktarını yitirmek.

definition_en: to distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
example_sentence: The university allocated substantial grant funding to the biomedical engineering department.
turkish_hint: Bütçeyi veya zamanı belirli bir hedefe pay etmek.

definition_en: based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system
example_sentence: Grading rubrics ensure that student essay evaluations are objective rather than arbitrary.
turkish_hint: Belirli bir mantığa dayanmayan, kafaya göre verilen karar.

definition_en: stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt
example_sentence: The exam guidelines provide explicit instructions regarding word count limits for the essay.
turkish_hint: 'Implicit' (üstü kapalı) kelimesinin zıttı; hiçbir şüpheye yer bırakmayacak kadar açık.

definition_en: formed by combining several separate elements into a whole
example_sentence: Your final proficiency result is calculated as an aggregate score of reading, listening, and writing.
turkish_hint: Farklı bölümlerin toplanıp tek bir bileşik rakam haline gelmesi.

definition_en: including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
example_sentence: PrepMaster offers a comprehensive overview of all grammar topics tested in Turkish university exams.
turkish_hint: Her şeyi içine alan, hiçbir açığı bırakmayan geniş kapsam.

definition_en: denoting an action or event preceding or done in preparation for something fuller or more important
example_sentence: Preliminary results from the lab trials demonstrate strong potential for cancer treatment.
turkish_hint: Asıl aşamadan önce yapılan ilk yoklama ve ön hazırlık.

definition_en: to make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse
example_sentence: Rampant inflation and currency depreciation will exacerbate socioeconomic inequality in developing nations.
turkish_hint: Yaraya tuz basmak; zaten kötü olan bir durumu çekilmez hale getirmek.

definition_en: to confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding with additional evidence
example_sentence: Subsequent laboratory experiments independently corroborated the initial astrophysical discovery.
turkish_hint: Bir iddiayı sağlam kanıtlarla arkalamak, sağlama bağlamak.

definition_en: a division or contrast between two things that are or are represented as being opposed or entirely different
example_sentence: The essay challenges the rigid dichotomy between quantitative and qualitative research methodologies.
turkish_hint: Siyah-beyaz gibi iki zıt kutup arasına çekilen kalın çizgi.

definition_en: a great difference, especially an unfair inequality
example_sentence: Policymakers must address the growing economic disparity between metropolitan and rural areas.
turkish_hint: İki taraf arasındaki adil olmayan dev fark ve uçurum.

definition_en: present, appearing, or found everywhere
example_sentence: Smartphones have become so ubiquitous that life without instant connectivity is virtually unimaginable.
turkish_hint: Nereye baksanız karşınıza çıkan, her köşe başında var olan.

definition_en: to make something clear; explain thoroughly
example_sentence: The doctoral thesis aims to elucidate the neural mechanisms responsible for short-term memory consolidation.
turkish_hint: Karanlık veya karmaşık bir konunun üzerine fener tutarak anlaşılır kılmak.

definition_en: to make something, typically an undesirable situation or an unfounded belief, continue indefinitely
example_sentence: Flawed algorithmic hiring models can inadvertently perpetuate systemic workplace biases.
turkish_hint: Genellikle kötü bir durumu veya önyargıyı nesilden nesile devam ettirmek.

meaning_tr: eldeki veriden hareketle geleceğe/bilinmeyene dair çıkarım yapmak
definition_en: to extend the application of a conclusion to an unknown situation by assuming that existing trends will continue
example_sentence: Demographers extrapolate future urban population densities from recent regional census metrics.
turkish_hint: Eldeki sınırlı grafikten yola çıkarak bilinmeyen geleceğe çizgi çekmek.

definition_en: lasting for a very short time
example_sentence: Social media popularity is notoriously ephemeral, fading rapidly as public attention shifts.
turkish_hint: Tıpkı bir kelebeğin ömrü veya su damlası gibi çok çabuk kaybolup giden.

definition_en: as appears or is stated to be true, though not necessarily so; apparently
example_sentence: The trade tariffs were ostensibly imposed to protect domestic laborers, but geopolitical motives dominated.
turkish_hint: Vitrine konulan sebep öyle olsa da arkasında başka bir gerçeğin yattığını ima eden zarf.

definition_en: to provide evidence to support or prove the truth of a claim or hypothesis
example_sentence: The research team must substantiate their controversial hypothesis with statistically reproducible laboratory trials.
collocation: substantiate a claim / substantiate an allegation / substantiate findings
turkish_hint: Soyut bir iddiayı elle tutulur somut (substance) kanıtlarla besleyip ispatlamak.

definition_en: to increase rapidly in numbers or multiply at a fast pace
example_sentence: Online misinformation platforms proliferate rapidly in the absence of robust algorithmic content moderation.
collocation: proliferate rapidly / weapons proliferate / cells proliferate
turkish_hint: Mantar gibi bir anda her yerde türemek ve sayıca hızla katlanmak.

meaning_tr: ana hatlarıyla betimlemek, sınırlarını açıkça çizmek
definition_en: to describe, portray, or set forth the boundaries of something with precision
example_sentence: The doctoral dissertation clearly delineates the ethical boundaries between observational fieldwork and clinical intervention.
collocation: delineate boundaries / delineate a strategy / delineate responsibilities
turkish_hint: İçindeki 'line' (çizgi) kökünden hatırla; sınırları cetvelle çizer gibi netleştirmek.

definition_en: to reach a climax, highest point, or decisive final outcome after a long process
example_sentence: Years of meticulous diplomatic negotiations culminated in the signing of the historic multilateral treaty.
collocation: culminate in success / culminate in a crisis / culminate in an agreement
turkish_hint: Uzun bir sürecin sonunda en tepe noktaya (culmination) varıp bir sonuçla taçlanması.

definition_en: to cause, give rise to, or bring into existence a particular feeling, situation, or condition
example_sentence: Opaque decision-making in public institutions tends to engender widespread citizen cynicism and distrust.
collocation: engender distrust / engender controversy / engender debate
turkish_hint: Genetik/üreme kökünden gelir; bir durumu veya duyguyu tohum gibi ekip filizlendirmek.

meaning_tr: iyileştirmek, daha iyi duruma getirmek, ıslah etmek
definition_en: to make something that is bad, unpleasant, or deficient significantly better
example_sentence: Targeted social welfare stipends are designed to ameliorate extreme rural poverty and food insecurity.
collocation: ameliorate conditions / ameliorate suffering / ameliorate poverty
turkish_hint: 'Exacerbate' (kötüleştirmek) zıttıdır; yarayı sarıp durumu iyileştirmek.

definition_en: to refuse to accept, acknowledge, or be associated with; to reject the validity of
example_sentence: The scientific committee formally repudiated the discredited study due to widespread data fabrication.
collocation: repudiate a claim / repudiate an agreement / repudiate findings
turkish_hint: Bir iddiayı veya anlaşmayı kesin bir dille masadan itip elinin tersiyle reddetmek.

meaning_tr: birbiriyle ilişkili olmak, karşılıklı bağıntı göstermek
definition_en: to have a mutual relationship or connection, in which one thing affects or depends on another
example_sentence: Socioeconomic status strongly correlates with educational attainment across standardized longitudinal studies.
collocation: correlate with performance / correlate strongly / positively correlate
turkish_hint: İki değişkenin grafik üzerinde el ele tutuşarak birlikte artması veya azalması.

meaning_tr: sentezlemek, farklı unsurları bir araya getirip bütünleştirmek
definition_en: to combine diverse ideas, substances, or components into a coherent, unified whole
example_sentence: In the literature review, graduate students must synthesize conflicting scholarly arguments into a coherent conceptual framework.
collocation: synthesize data / synthesize information / synthesize findings
turkish_hint: Farklı kaynaklardaki ham bilgileri eritip tek bir potada yeni bir ürün ortaya çıkarmak.

meaning_tr: resmen ilan etmek, yaymak, yürürlüğe koymak
definition_en: to promote, broadcast, or officially put a law, decree, or doctrine into public effect
example_sentence: The ministry promulgated comprehensive regulatory directives to govern artificial intelligence deployment in healthcare.
collocation: promulgate a law / promulgate a policy / promulgate standards
turkish_hint: Devletin veya kurumun resmi gazetede basarak kanunu tüm topluma duyurması.

definition_en: to restrict something within definite limits or draw a boundary around it
example_sentence: The supreme court ruling effectively circumscribed executive authority during peacetime national emergencies.
collocation: circumscribe authority / circumscribe freedom / circumscribe power
turkish_hint: 'Circle' (daire) ve 'scribe' (yazmak/çizmek); etrafına çember çizip hareket alanını daraltmak.

definition_en: to perceive, recognize, or distinguish something with difficulty or keen intellect
example_sentence: Trained art historians can readily discern authentic Renaissance canvases from modern deceptive forgeries.
collocation: discern differences / discern a pattern / discern the truth
turkish_hint: Bulanık veya karmaşık bir ortamda ince ayrıntıyı göz ucuyla veya akılla yakalamak.

meaning_tr: engel olmak, imkânsız kılmak, önüne geçmek
definition_en: to prevent something from happening or make it entirely impossible in advance
example_sentence: A prior history of cardiovascular complications does not necessarily preclude participation in moderate exercise.
collocation: preclude the possibility / preclude from participating / preclude an investigation
turkish_hint: 'Exclude' gibi kapıyı peşinen kilitleyip baştan imkansız hale getirmek.

meaning_tr: yankılanmak, derin ve sarsıcı etkiler bırakmak
definition_en: to echo repeatedly; to have continuing and widespread shock or influence over an extended period
example_sentence: The collapse of the major investment bank reverberated throughout international capital markets for years.
collocation: reverberate through society / reverberate globally / reverberate across industries
turkish_hint: Vadide atılan bir çığlığın veya düşen bir bombanın tüm dağlarda dalga dalga yankı yapması.

meaning_tr: birleşmek, kaynaşmak, tek vücut haline gelmek
definition_en: to come together to form one larger mass, group, or whole
example_sentence: Disparate grassroots environmental groups coalesced into a powerful national coalition advocating climate justice.
collocation: coalesce into a movement / coalesce around an idea / interests coalesce
turkish_hint: Ayrı su damlalarının akıp tek bir büyük gölcükte kaynaşması.

meaning_tr: örneklemek, somut örneği olmak, timsali olmak
definition_en: to be a quintessential or typical example of something; to illustrate by giving an example
example_sentence: The newly inaugurated sustainable campus exemplifies state-of-the-art zero-emission architectural engineering.
collocation: exemplify the trend / exemplify success / exemplify the principles
turkish_hint: 'Example' kelimesinin akademik fiil hali; 'örnek teşkil etmek / tipik göstergesi olmak'.

definition_en: to reduce the force, intensity, effect, or thickness of something
example_sentence: Dense coastal mangrove forests attenuate the destructive velocity of hurricane storm surges.
collocation: attenuate the impact / attenuate risk / attenuate the signal
turkish_hint: Mühendislikte sinyal sönümleme; şiddetli bir darbenin veya dalganın gücünü kırıp inceltmek.

definition_en: to demand or specify a requirement as an essential part of an agreement or law
example_sentence: The university grant stipulates that all research findings must be made immediately accessible via open-access repositories.
collocation: stipulate conditions / contract stipulates / law stipulates that
turkish_hint: Sözleşmeye kırmızı çizgi çekip 'bu olmadan olmaz' diye kesin madde koymak.

definition_en: to shock or excite someone into taking rapid, purposeful action
example_sentence: The alarming climate report galvanized international civil society into demanding immediate legislative emissions caps.
collocation: galvanize support / galvanize the public / galvanize action
turkish_hint: Elektrik akımı verilmiş gibi uyuşukluğu dağıtıp kitleleri anında aksiyona geçirmek.

definition_en: to suggest or accept the truth of something as a basis for reasoning, discussion, or belief
example_sentence: Theoretical physicists postulate the existence of dark matter to account for galactic rotational velocities.
collocation: postulate a theory / postulate the existence of / postulate that
turkish_hint: Henüz ispatlanmasa bile teorik çıkarım yapabilmek için kabul edilen temel aksiyom/varsayım.
